name: uae-public-service-continuity-agent
description: Deterministic local multi-agent candidate for synthetic UAE public-service continuity evaluation.

scripts.demo: node src/cli.js run --fixture fixtures/s1-s5.json --out evidence/runs/reference --source-verification metadata-only
scripts.demo:public: node src/cli.js run --fixture fixtures/s1-s5.json --out evidence/runs/reference --source-verification metadata-only
scripts.verify: node src/cli.js verify --run evidence/runs/reference --oracle verifier/oracles/s1-s5.oracle.json --fixture fixtures/s1-s5.json --out evidence/verification/reference-receipt.json --source-verification metadata-only
scripts.verify:public: node src/cli.js verify --run evidence/runs/reference --oracle verifier/oracles/s1-s5.oracle.json --fixture fixtures/s1-s5.json --out evidence/verification/reference-receipt.json --source-verification metadata-only
scripts.metrics: node src/cli.js metrics --run evidence/runs/reference --receipt evidence/verification/reference-receipt.json --opportunities fixtures/opportunities.json --out evidence/metrics/reference-metrics.json
scripts.scenario:technical: node src/cli.js run --fixture fixtures/technical-test-scenario.json --out evidence/runs/technical-test --source-verification metadata-only
